net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.Resizer resizer = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.BicubicResizer();
java.util.Map<java.awt.RenderingHints.Key, Object> hints = resizer.getRenderingHints();

assert hints != null : "Hints map should not be null";
assert hints.containsKey(java.awt.RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION) : "Hints should contain KEY_INTERPOLATION";

Object interpValue = hints.get(java.awt.RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION);
assert java.awt.RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BICUBIC.equals(interpValue) : "Expected bicubic interpolation hint";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ getRenderingHints " + interpValue);
